title: A Morning at the Station
body: Mika missed the early train on Monday morning. She stood on the platform and watched the doors close. The next train would come in twelve minutes. A cold wind moved along the tracks, so she pulled her coat closer. Near the bench, a baker sold warm bread from a small cart. The smell of butter made her hungry, but she had no coins in her pocket. She checked the clock above the stairs and took a slow breath. A student beside her was reading a thin book and smiling at one page. When the train arrived, people stepped back to let others out first. Mika found a seat by the window and opened her bag. Inside was a red apple and a note from her brother. The note said, "Have a good day." She ate the apple and felt a little better.
